explanation: Delegates of 50 countries signed its charter in San Francisco in June 1945. Poland signed later, so the UN counts 51 founding members.

claims.text: The United Nations was founded in 1945 as the successor to the League of Nations.
The World Bank, the Red Cross and the Commonwealth did not succeed the League of Nations.
Delegates of 50 countries signed the UN Charter in San Francisco in June 1945.
Poland signed the charter later and is one of the UN's 51 original members.
